moves.name: Nasty Bite
moves.notes: Always followed by Wriggle. Always used at the start of combat. Wrigglers in slots 1 and 3 start with this move. It is always followed by "Wriggle".

moves.name: Wriggle
moves.notes: Always followed by Nasty Bite. Always used at the start of combat. Wrigglers in slots 2 and 4 start with this move. It adds Infection , gains 2 Strength , then is always followed by "Nasty Bite".

moves.name: Spawned
moves.notes: Always used at the start of combat. If Wriggler enters as spawned/stunned, it performs this empty action first. Afterward it enters the normal loop based on its slot.
